title: docs(adr-0079): addendum — a formula title reads one hop through a reference, and is not sortable or searchable
body:
Fixes #24197

Clause-②: no (an ADR note records what shipped; it moves no accept set and no public surface. The governed path owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review, and the PR lands only on a governed approver's approval: Tier H.)

## Summary

The third and last of card #24197's three parts: the ruling's documentation leg, "written as an ADR-0079 note". One appended section in `docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md`, `## Addendum (2026-10-18, #24197) — a formula title reads one hop through a reference, and is not sortable or searchable`, plus one `- **Addenda**:` pointer line in the header block (the spelling ADR-0048 uses). Docs-only: `skip-changeset`.

The addendum names ruling 6245544505 (letter A on objectstack-ai/cloud#2925) and the two PRs that shipped it, quotes the ruling verbatim, then states nine facts about `main` in three groups (read path, hook bodies, sort and search), and ends with what it qualifies above. It qualifies the `## Alternatives considered` first bullet ("the server *can* return and query") and D1's "real STORED" in its own text; neither is edited. No edit to Provenance, Context, D1–D10, the status table, the open questions or the alternatives.

Sources combined, as the dispatch named them: part 1's `adr_note_text` (report 6247217617), amended with record 6247399985's ③.4 (`user` and `tree` are references) and ③.8b (FLS on the carrying reference column); part 2's `adr_note_addendum` (report 6248949940), amended with record 6249342777's ③.7 (the channel's identity, the channel that cannot read, FLS on the title field).

"Shown on every surface" is not carried. The addendum names the two surfaces verified (the engine read path and the hook-body title accessor) and says it makes no statement about any other consumer of a record's title.

## Verification record

Every statement checked in code on `main` at the merge `da22e1db` (merge base `2b7fc52c3`). The rework head `73fd87521c` (report 6250259693) changes two addendum lines only, the hook-bodies heading and the provenance sentence, and none of the files below. *(Note added by the seat.)* The merge brought `#24305`, `#24308`, `#24312`; `git diff --stat 2950277 da22e1db` over every file below is empty. `d537a318b` and `1bf5f6e17c` are ancestors of the head (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`: exit 0 for both).

| # | Statement | File · symbol |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | One hop through `lookup` / `master_detail` / `user` / `tree`; one batched read per reference field per page; the reader's own permissions; on `find`, `findOne` and the insert and update responses | `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` · `resolveFormulaRelated` → `resolveOneHopRelated(…, 'caller')` (hop query carries the caller's `context`, no `isSystem` spread; `where id $in`), call sites in `find`, `findOne` and the two `hydrateWriteFormulas` callers; `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts` · `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` = lookup, master_detail, user, tree, read through `referenceTargetOf` |
| 2 | Missing or unreadable related record → `null` with a reason, never a fallback, the reason not saying which; an empty reference is evaluated | `engine.ts` · `formulaHopScope` (`ok: false` before evaluation; `no-reference` → evaluated), `formulaHopRefusal` (docblock: never says which of not-found / not-readable held), `applyFormulaPlan` |
| 3 | Lint refuses a second hop and a bare-and-traversed reference; run time reads `null` with the same reason; a related object's own hop is not served when read as a hop | `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` · `judgeFieldFormula` passes `traversalHydration: true`; `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` · `TRAVERSAL_CONFLICT_CODE` (`traversal-multi-hop`, `traversal-bare-and-traversed`); `engine.ts` · `hopConflict` in `applyFormulaPlan`, `formulaHopReads` in `resolveFormulaRelated` |
| 4 | FLS on the carrying reference column does not stop the hop; formulas computed before the mask; control is FLS on the formula field | `engine.ts` · `find` evaluates `applyFormulaPlan` on the driver rows inside the operation; `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` · `maskOperationResult` masks `opCtx.result` afterwards |
| 5 | `ctx.title()` over the in-flight state, one batched read per reference field on the body's `ctx.api` channel, its identity (SYSTEM under `runAs: 'system'`) and transaction; null cases | `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` · `buildTitleSurface` (`hookRecordState`, `resolveServedRecordTitle`); `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` · title wire hands `txState.api ?? ctx.api`, `value ?? null`; `engine.ts` · `ScopedContext.serveFormulaField` (its `executionContext`), `ScopedContext.withRunAs` (`'system'` → `sudo()`); `packages/objectql/src/record-title.ts` · `resolveServedRecordTitle` |
| 6 | A channel that cannot read (`runAs: 'user'`, no user) serves no hop: own-column title resolves, title over a reference `null` | `engine.ts` · `withRunAs` (no `userId` → `UnscopedHookApi`); `packages/objectql/src/hook-run-as.ts` · `UnscopedHookApi` (no `serveFormulaField`); `body-runner.ts` · `buildTitleSurface` falls to `resolveRecordTitle` |
| 7 | FLS on the title field is not applied to `ctx.title()` | `engine.ts` · `ObjectQL.serveFormulaField` returns `scratch[field]` with no mask; `record-title.ts` · `resolveRecordTitle` / `resolveServedRecordTitle` apply none |
| 8 | `ctx.title('FIELD')` answers the title as `findOne` served it, the related record's own one-hop title included | `body-runner.ts` · `buildTitleSurface` → `source.object(…).findOne` → `servedRecordTitle` |
| 9 | Stored nowhere; sort `400 INVALID_SORT`; request `searchFields` `400 INVALID_FIELD`; a `searchableFields` entry dropped; never in the auto-default set | `engine.ts` · `assertOrderByIsMaterializable` (formula in `orderBy`, `find` and `findOne`); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` · `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` (`virtual` branch, `INVALID_FIELD`, 400); `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` · `resolveSearchFieldResolution` (declared entries filtered by `isVirtualSearchField`), `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` = formula, `autoDefaultFields` (formula in neither positive list) |

The header pointer's fragment equals `github-slugger`'s slug of the new heading (computed, identical).

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on `da22e1db`: 19 commands, the same 19 as on the pre-merge head `2950277`, and the dispatch's count of 19. All 19 ran on `da22e1db`, each exit captured before any pipe: 19 × exit 0, among them `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`, `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`. `--ran`: "19 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 19 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

On the first sweep (`2950277`), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built in the new worktree). Not counted as a measurement; after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` (under the verify lock, exit 0) it exited 0, and 0 again on `da22e1db`.

No package is touched, so no build closure, test suite or typecheck is owed. CI check-runs: not read at this writing; CI's verdict is the record.

## Acceptance notes

- The addendum does not describe any in-flight change: it names no open card and describes no unlanded path.
- Out of scope, noted only: other consumers of a record's title (global search hits, approvals messages) were not verified for a title over lookups, and the addendum makes no statement about them.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
在 ADR-0079(记录标题契约)末尾追加一节附录,并在文件头加一行指向它。附录只陈述已经上线的事实:公式字段可以穿过一个引用字段读取关联记录(一跳),读取时用读者自己的权限;看不到或不存在的关联记录让公式为空,不给回退值;两跳被 lint 拒绝;钩子里的 `ctx.title()` 也按同样方式取标题;由多个查找字段拼成的标题不落库,所以不能按它排序、不能按它搜索。

**为什么改**
裁决 6245544505(cloud#2925 字母 A)要求这条决定「写成 ADR-0079 的一则说明」。代码部分已由 #24274 和 #24307 落地,本 PR 是这张卡的最后一块:让 AI 和开发者读 ADR 时就知道「拼接标题」能显示、不能排序搜索,需要排序搜索就另存一个字段。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
只改一份文档,不动代码、不动契约、不发布任何包。风险是文字与实现不符;每句话都在 PR 正文里对应到了具体文件和符号。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。

**席位意见**


**你要做的(一个动作)**
读完附录,无异议就批准本 PR(Tier H,需维护者批准后由席位落地)。
